briefdescription.para: Execute a two-phase commit for a cross-shard transaction.

detaileddescription.para:
This method drives both phases synchronously:
Sends PREPARE to each shard listed in ops_per_shard.
If all vote COMMIT → sends COMMIT to all; otherwise ABORT to all.
Only shards present in ops_per_shard participate. Shards not listed are not contacted.
